articles.summary: Skyward Specialty announced the appointment of Melissa Goto as President, E&S Brokerage and Inland Marine, to lead the strategic development of those businesses. Goto brings more than 25 years of underwriting and leadership experience, most recently as Head of P&C Specialty Lines at Intact Insurance, with prior leadership roles at Chubb and Travelers.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty Appoints Melissa Goto to Lead E&S Brokerage and Inland Marine Businesses - Skyward Specialty Insurance

articles.summary: The 2023 banking crisis reshaped the depository bond market — exposing underwriting gaps, contracting capacity, and forcing banks and sureties to adapt. Learn what changed and what it means for the surety market today.
articles.title: From Crisis to Caution: How the 2023 Banking Crisis Reshaped the Bankruptcy Depository Bond Market
